sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Refer to 'WSLHD_5830_EOI Part B - Tender Specifications'.

Every day, thousands of people pass through Blacktown Hospital — nurses starting a shift, new parents on their way home, families waiting on news, specialists between rounds. They all need somewhere to grab a coffee, collect a prescription, or pick up a gift on the way to a bedside. That everyday need is now an opportunity with seven retail tenancies being available for lease at the very centre of the campus.

The Seven tenancies available are located across Ground floor (Level 3) of the Clinical Services and Main Entry Buildings — lease one or several.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Refer to 'WSLHD_5830_EOI Part B - Tender Specifications'.

The Opportunity

- Seven tenancies
- Expansive shopfronts
- Full base building services available
- Tenancies ranging from 18-236sqm
- Strong 7day foot traffic
- Individual leases will be issued per tenancy, tailor your footprint to your concept.

Specifically Seeking

We're inviting expressions of interest from operators who want to be part of a captive, high-frequency trading environment — particularly:

1. Pharmacy operator

2. Café / specialty coffee operator

3. Food court operators — Halal, South Asian, Middle Eastern & vegetarian cuisines

4. Sushi bar / fresh food QSR

5. Convenience store / newsagency

6. Florist & gift retailer

7. Tenancies ranging from 18 – 236sqm
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content: This is a two-stage tender consisting of an Expression of Interest (EOI) stage and Request for Tender (RFT) stage with suitable suppliers in the EOI stage being selected to participate in the RFT stage.
